services.desc: As your ship slips into the port of Bar Harbor, Maine the scenery becomes breathtaking. Situated on the eastern shore of Mount Desert Island (MDI), this rugged yet picturesque corner of America is the largest island off the coast of Maine. Encompassing an area of 108 square miles, MDI is home to Acadia National Park whose mountains stretch over 1,500 feet tall! Your Dilemma: How do you see everything that this landscape has to offer in just a few hours? The Answer: Sign up for one of Acadia Air Tours’ scenic flights.
